subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should this PR's currentAttemptReplayMetadata result field and server_error retry-before-failover behavior become the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97877 once stronger real-runner proof is added?
rationale: The code shape looks like the right narrow bug fix, but it changes an SDK-exported attempt result shape and provider-failure routing in a session/message-delivery sensitive path.

options.title: Accept this shape after proof
options.body: Require redacted full-runner or gateway proof, then proceed with this current-attempt metadata split as the canonical fix.

options.title: Use another open candidate
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97966 or another candidate as the canonical landing path if its proof and implementation are preferred.

options.title: Reject the new result field
options.body: Ask for a different same-attempt side-effect signal if maintainers do not want to extend the embedded attempt result contract.

recommendation.title: Accept this shape after proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted full-runner or gateway proof, then proceed with this current-attempt metadata split as the canonical fix.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the embedded runner retry/replay boundary and committed adjacent recovery changes.
